title: PIMActivation Corporate Branding Configuration
description: Runtime branding configuration for PIMActivation portal tenants (logos, theme colors, and custom enterprise links).

$schema.description: URI to the branding JSON Schema for IDE validation.

companyName.description: Optional company name used for logo alt text and fallback if logo fails to load.

logo.description: Custom company logo URLs and sizing.

light.description: URL or relative path to the logo used on light backgrounds or default light mode.

dark.description: Optional URL or relative path to the logo used on dark backgrounds or dark mode.

favicon.description: Optional URL or relative path to a custom browser tab favicon (.ico, .svg, or .png).

height.description: Optional CSS height value for the logo (e.g., '28px', '32px'). Defaults to '28px'.

theme.description: Corporate theme colors applied to root CSS variables.

primaryColor.description: Primary brand color (mapped to --brand-primary) used for active states, highlights, and key buttons.

accentColor.description: Accent brand color (mapped to --brand-accent) used for secondary highlights and badge tints.

navTextColor.description: Navigation text and icon color (mapped to --brand-nav-text).

backgroundColor.description: Optional custom page canvas / background color (mapped to --brand-bg and --bg-base).

navigation.description: Up to 3 custom enterprise navigation links rendered in the header.

label.description: Display text for the link button (e.g. 'Helpdesk', 'Wiki').
